statement: At 1 uM, imidacloprid occupancy on insect nAChR is >= 0.9 while vertebrate a4b2 occupancy stays <= 0.2 (dual scorecard gap > 0).
The same dose lowers model drive through ACh edges in the MN9/DNp01 neighborhood: g_ach falls and the network mean rate falls with it.
Fipronil at 1 uM lowers g_gaba (RDL block) and disinhibits the neighborhood: the network mean rate rises above vehicle.
Diazepam occupies vertebrate GABA-A and does not occupy insect RDL in this library, so it moves no fly readout: the predicted circuit effect is exactly zero.
Bitter input vetoes sugar-driven MN9 on the map-extracted labellar-GRN path (Shiu 2024 direction): adding bitter drive lowers MN9 below the sugar-only rate in vehicle.

Fipronil at 1 uM relieves the bitter veto on the map path: the bitter veto ratio (MN9 sugar+bitter / MN9 sugar) rises above its vehicle value because RDL block removes the inhibition that carries the veto.

Picrotoxin is the non-selective control: it perturbs the fly neighborhood (RDL block raises the mean rate) while its receptor selectivity index is ~0, so any insect-selectivity claim must fail for it.
